title: Word Count Report
statement:
Count normalized words in a block of text and return a deterministic report.

Contract
- `text` is non-null and may be empty or all whitespace.
- Split on whitespace. For each token, remove leading and trailing non-letter-or-digit characters, then lowercase the remaining text.
- Discard tokens that become empty.
- Return strings of the form `count word`, sorted first by word length and then lexicographically.

Examples
- `countWords("Red fish, red fish!")` returns `["2 red", "2 fish"]`.
- `countWords("One two two three.")` returns `["1 one", "2 two", "1 three"]`.
- `countWords(" ... ")` returns `[]`.
hints: Normalize every token before counting so punctuation and case do not split the same word.
A map from word to count gives the frequency table in one pass.
Sort the map entries by word length and then by word to make the output stable. Intended complexity: O(n log n) time from sorting distinct words and O(n) space.
inputSyntax: Input: text to count, for example: Red fish, red fish!
